title: Add typed payload shapes for renderer snapshot and choice objects
description: The top-level game export types already guarantee `Decision` and `Snapshot` fields like `turn`, `player`, `choices`, `players`, and `stack`, so those callers can fail fast. But nested payloads used by `decision_renderer.py` are still mostly `object`/`JsonObject`: battlefield permanents, stack items, combat groups, incoming attackers, and decision choices. That forces `.get("name")` / `.get("id")` style access even where those fields are semantically required by the renderer. Introduce typed shapes for the nested renderer-facing payloads and thread them through the export schema so the renderer and blunder-analysis code can use direct indexing for required fields.
